_note: RY5088 + sibling-platform device map, regenerated from the MonsGeek/RongYuan V4 driver board catalog. dev_id == GET_INFOR id (16-bit LE); the USB PID is shared across models, so dev_id is the only safe discriminator. Entries whose platform is not 'ry5088' are recognised for display only — the flasher refuses any image that is not an AT32F405 keyboard build.
